verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance documents vendor-run background automation: its software files annual reports automatically in every state as they come due through direct secretary-of-state integrations, and a Company Profile update automatically propagates records across jurisdictions. These are fixed, built-in automations rather than workflows a user defines. Customizable reminders are an adjacent feature, and the client-credentials API is only a developer building block, so neither earns credit here. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or workflow builder, user-defined triggers and schedules, automation beyond annual reports and profile sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
